title: Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai II
native_title: アイドル雀士スーチーパイⅡ
overview:
Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai II is an adult strip mahjong game. Shiho Katagiri has been kidnapped, and Suchie-Pai sets out to find out who is behind it. Beat each rival in one-on-one mahjong to win her over as an ally, and work your way toward the mastermind.

Both you and your opponents can use cheating techniques, and winning hands earn turns at a memory-style panel match that rewards new cheats and points. The Saturn version eases the difficulty compared with the arcade game and adds Yuki Mizuno as an opponent, with a special episode to play once every scenario is cleared.

- Two discs, with a bonus disc holding free play matches, voice actor interviews and a sound test
- Four new cheating mahjong players and a new boss

Rated for players 18 and over.
